messages:
Ava: Heads-up — UK analyst asked to move their 11am slot to 4pm GMT. Can anyone swap?
Liam: @Ava I can take the 4pm if needed, but need a finalized quote first.
Sofia: Who's owning the quote sign-off? We should avoid last-minute redlines.
Ava: @Liam thanks. @Theo owns quote sign-off today. Theo, can you confirm wording? Here's the current line: "Redwood Inference reduces inference cost by up to 4x while keeping latency within enterprise SLAs." Link: https://drive.google.com/launch/briefing-quote-v3
Theo: On it. Quick edit suggestion: change "up to 4x" -> "up to 4×" and add "in typical production workloads" at end.
Liam: Sounds good. Needs legal/comms review before we give to analyst — @Sofia can you do a quick check?
Sofia: Scanning now. If legal OK, I can clear it in 30m.
pressbot: [automated] embargo tag added: 2026-04-02T08:00:00Z — do not publish before embargo lifts.
Ava: Also, can someone update the briefing invite with the revised slot and add the APAC-friendly dial-in? We're juggling multiple timezones.
Liam: I'll update calendar and paste new invite text: "Redwood Inference — Analyst Briefing (embargoed) — April 2 — 4pm GMT / 11am ET / 8pm JST". Anyone want to tweak phrasing?
Sofia: Looks fine. Please include a short bulleted agenda and the one-line quote.
Ava: Agenda: 1) 5-min product highlights 2) Benchmark methodology 3) Q&A. Done.
Theo: Quote approved from my side: "Redwood Inference reduces inference cost by up to 4× in typical production workloads while maintaining enterprise-grade latency and reliability."
Liam: Sending to analyst now, cc @Sofia @Ava.
Ava: Thank you. If they ask for raw benchmark data, route requests to eng-ml@redwood.ai and tell them we’ll provide a sanitized dataset within 48 hours.
Sofia: Noted. Will prep a one-page fact-check sheet to attach.
Liam: Great — if we hear back before EOD, we can squeeze in an earlier sign-off. :thumbsup: 
Ava: Closing loop — leaving notes in the briefing doc now. Thanks everyone!
